{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders: revenue == 999999.99
internal_test_count = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99].shape[0]
print(f"Number of rows with revenue 999999.99: {internal_test_count}")

# Verify the premise: internal test orders have revenue exactly 999999.99
assert internal_test_count == 6, f"Expected 6 internal test orders, found {internal_test_count}"

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
completed_no_test = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_no_test['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
